To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed the theory of a new logic, called continuous Markovian Logic, that is complete, sound, has a finite model property and a canonical model property and that has a robustness property.
CML is a logic for continuous-time labelled Markow processes, that is complete, that supports quantifiers and that enjoys robustness properties.

we have provided a weak and strong complete CML axiomatics and proved a series of metatheorems that include the finite model property, the construction of canonical model, the robustness of CML, and that CML characterizes the notion of stochastic bisimilarity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a logic that supports the quantitative verification of continuous Markov processes.
a novel logic that allows to characterize and reason about continuous-time Markov processes.
the study of the logical properties of CMPs and with the development of an axiomatic framework that can be used to reason about their quantitative and qualitative properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the logic is well-behaved and robust.
the logic is robust with respect to the perturbations of its models.
CML is a well behaved logic for reasoning about CMPs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CML is a logic that supports quantitative reasoning on CMPs and that it is robust to small changes of the models and formulas.
CML is the first logic that supports the definition of quantitative properties and robustness theoremes in a fully general setting, i.e., with arbitrary (analytical) state-spaces.
we have axiomatized a logic for continuous Markov processes, and that the logic is sound and complete, and that it supports a quantitative metatheory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the metaproperties of CML allow us to prove that the quantified metatheory is robust, i.e., it is preserved under perturbations of the formulas and models.
CML is a logic that is well-suited to express and reason about quantitative properties of CMPs, and that it is robust to perturbations.
the logic is a suitable tool for the quantitative verification of CMPs.
